name: Dynamic Optimal Sampling Layer
definition: A three-stage sampling strategy (coarse, optimal, fine) that inserts an optimal sampling layer between coarse and fine sampling to adaptively adjust the number and locations of new sample points based on priorities from the previous stage, targeting high-weight regions.
summary: The Dynamic Optimal Sampling Layer is a three-stage strategy that inserts an adaptive optimal layer between coarse and fine sampling to prioritize high-weight regions, improving efficiency in sparse reconstruction.
